note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sends a 240 point Guard unit on a 17% charge at a lone 85 point Beastboss. The positive terms (ch_damage, ch_can_wipe, ch_can_halve, ch_character) cancel the strong ch_chance penalty and leave a score of 0.55. That is too close to zero for such a poor roll. Fix: Multiply all positive payoff terms by the charge probability. Add a retaliation term for the exposed position after the charge. Add a penalty for leaving a held objective. Require a minimum score margin, for example above 3, before a charge below 25% chance is declared.
